identified_problem: The game does not provide options for selecting difficulty levels.
redesign_response: Difficulty-management concerns were mitigated through trimester-based progression, with mechanics and decision complexity introduced gradually.

identified_problem: The game does not adapt to the player's performance or skill level.
redesign_response: Staged progression was introduced to control increasing complexity; however, performance-based adaptation was not implemented.

identified_problem: Interface elements are not sufficiently intuitive without external guidance.
redesign_response: Interactive objects received visual highlights and interaction cues to improve their visibility and affordance.

identified_problem: Controls and interaction elements do not follow standard conventions.
redesign_response: Interaction guidance was strengthened through the narrative-integrated tutorial, while Notebook access and navigation were simplified.

identified_problem: Feedback provided to the player lacks clarity and explanatory detail.
redesign_response: Feedback was expanded to explain unmet quality requirements, attribute mismatches, and architectural patterns better suited to each contract.

identified_problem: The game does not provide any mechanism to save progress.
redesign_response: Trimester-based progression, unlockable content, and longer-term team-management mechanics were introduced, but persistent save functionality was not implemented.

identified_problem: The game offers limited emotional engagement and lacks narrative elements.
redesign_response: An introductory narrative and the mascot Clipper were introduced to contextualize the player's role and integrate tutorial guidance into the game world.

identified_problem: The game does not allow instructors to customize or create challenges.
redesign_response: Contracts were redesigned with a more modular structure to facilitate future content expansion, but instructor-driven challenge creation was not implemented.

identified_problem: There are no mechanisms to monitor or analyze player performance.
redesign_response: Pattern-learning minigames and trimester assessments were added for practice and concept checking; longitudinal performance monitoring remains unsupported.
